translation.name: Raraŋ Aetaniacna Kam Wembaŋ Laŋ
translation.englishName: New Testament in Mborena Kam language

content: Iesusa roumb lepaapna ramoot ianmo moa laŋa moatna
Karica Iesusa an takur tɨkcarica irikatke, meikramtaɨr wɨt aniac ŋgoinna mamo maraŋgaiat.
Ri, roumb lepaapna ramoot ianna man ndambuŋa kɨpca tutupniŋ rɨmbɨtca manmo gaindopatna, “Kacoot u toŋgo te, u aukmo Raraŋ Aetaniacna lamnɨac ŋgoutmo mo laŋa moca rat ndaru.”
Karica ma ndona parmo an ramootmo utiŋga ma aindopatna, “Aku toŋgorena, u rat laŋa mo.” Na tawi ŋgoinna mana lepana roumbca maica, mana tikca rat laŋ mamoat.

Na ma an ramootmo gaind mac mbopatna, “U matau wat, u ramoot ianmo kai mbop teac, an reaca umo laruapeknanna. Na u taŋca ndona tikmo taup ndamootta taŋi wandac te, an Mosesa mboprina kirarmo, gɨmbamba mo te, meikramtaɨra watca lamŋinande, una roumbca mamairi.”
Lapoca ruŋrena ramoot paŋanna aiŋna ramootmo, Iesusa moa laŋa morina

Karica Iesusa taŋga Kapaneam auŋ tekera mbukatke, Romna lapoca ruŋrena ramoot paŋan ianna ma an ndeacrina. Na an lapoc ruŋrena ramoot paŋanna runduikta ramtaɨr mananna 100na mɨn, na ma kɨpca manmo ndo ŋgopotacna moca gagraca madigiat,
“Kacoot aukna mbaiŋna aiŋa morena ramootta, orpar menacrina roumbap tik, ma kac maeacreke, na ma gɨrgɨr aniacap.”
Ri, Iesusa rutica gaindopatna, “Aku taŋca manmo mo laŋa monande.”
Ri, lapoca ruŋrena ramoot paŋanna rutica gaindopatna, “Kacoot, aku irembta ramootta wanaiŋ, aintik u aukna kaca kɨpna mɨnna wanaiŋ. U kam niŋgik ndop te, aukna mbaiŋna aiŋa morena ramootta laŋa mona.

Na aku aindoprinanna, auk toco, aku iapna ramootna kaŋgauk ndeacrena. Ma ndo aukmo aiŋ neaŋ te, aku monande. Ainda moca aku ndona lapoca ruŋrena ramoot ianmo aindop te, ‘U taŋ,’ aindop te, ma taŋnande, na ian motoco aku aindop te, ‘U kɨp,’ aindop te, ma kɨpnande. Na aku ndona tuomna aiŋ kamaindna ramootmo aindop te, ‘U gan aiŋa mo!’ aindop te, ma taŋca an aiŋa monande.”

Ri, Iesusa an kamma waraca, mana iro inikca tamtam ŋgoin ndamŋica. Karica ma an mana raŋgairena meikramtaɨrmo gaindopatna, “Aku nemo gidik ŋgoin aindopnande, aku an Israelna wiwitna meacramootna, ianmo ainta rɨtɨpac gargar ianna wat ŋgocor.
“Aintik aku nemo aindopek, meikramtaɨr wɨt aniaca an ra gagambaiapa ra itirikmbaina pitrik waŋ ndiŋ nakɨpca tamuŋna auŋna bubuoca mbukca, mina Abraamapa Aisakapa Iakopap mbiraca amnande.

Na an meikramtaɨra Raraŋ Aetaniaca mimo ŋgaua babuca mana bubuoc ndeacrenanna, Raraŋ Aetaniaca minmo oot mandaca, neaup diriŋna ke laruca, mina ae ŋgoreac ŋgoin ŋgaeraŋ te, ndorita ndaɨrmo wiraŋnande.”

Karica Iesusa an lapoca ruŋrena ramoot paŋanmo aindopatna, “U taŋ, an reikca u rɨpacrina kirar ndarunande.” Na an kɨdrɨk ŋgoinna an lapoca ruŋrena ramoot paŋanna mbaiŋna aiŋa morena ramootta, laŋ mamoat.
Iesusa Pitana meacna aemma moa laŋa moatna
Karica Iesusa Pitana kaca mbukca wattatnanna, mana meacna aemma, tik owaina roumbca moca bara meraca eacri.
Ri, ma, mana parmo pipikatke, mana roumbca laŋa moatna mbatca, ma ŋgepca Iesusna amna reac makocroat.
Iesusa meikramtaɨr wɨtmo moa laŋa morina

Karica an wigwac ŋgoin mbuŋa mina an ŋerŋgaur ŋgorikca, minmo mbukca eacrina meikramtaɨrmo aŋgɨa Iesus ndambuŋ mataŋri. Na ma ndona up mbuŋa mbopri, an ŋerŋgaur ŋgorikca minmo tɨkcariri, na an roumbbebtanda ma minmo moca laiŋ mamori.
Na an tɨpna kirara Raraŋ Aetaniac mbopatna kamma ma moa mɨnna tɨkca ma ndona ramma morina ramoot Aisaiana upa tɨkca aindopatna, “Ma ndo ŋgoin mbuŋa aina roumbbebca ma aŋgɨca moa kecaririna.”
Iesusa ndoa raŋgaina tɨpemb kirarirna tɨpna nininia morina
Karica Iesusa wattatnanna meikramtaɨr wɨt aniaca manmo, punica korereri, na ma ndona raŋgairena ramtaɨrmo aindopatna, “Aia mɨarmo monmbai waŋ nagana.”
Ainda mori, tɨpemb wandik tamŋirena ramoot ianna kɨpca manmo aindopatna, “Riripti, u tenna taŋ te, aku una raŋgaica unap taŋraŋnande.”
Ri, ma, manmo aindopatna, “Raŋna piriŋ kunnara minanna ŋgorena tiacarpaikna aurembap, na ŋgorikca mitoco minanna ŋgorena timbap, na Ramootna Nuoca ma meraca ŋgogona taupemb kocor.”
Karica mana iŋa raŋgairena ramoot ianna manmo gaindopatna, “Kacoot, u aukmo pac watcarica, aku ndona aetna waɨr pac mutocarica.”
Aindopatke, Iesusa manmo gaindopatna, “Meikramtaɨra rɨtɨpaik kocorta meikramtaɨrta kirarirmo watcarica, mina ndorimo ndorita waɨrmo ndori mutoc te, u kɨpca aukmo raŋgai.”
Iesusa watapa murmurapa macaitmo mbopca mina menacatna
Karica Iesusa embatta kor ian naŋgabukatke, mana iŋa raŋgairena ramtaɨra manmo maraŋgaiat.
Na mina taŋri, Iesusa ma an korna inik maŋgori, na an mɨarna rɨkca tɨkatke, watapa, murmurapa macait aniaca ŋgepca, mina kormo pi bururuna tekemmotem.
Aintik mina taŋga manmo omboŋga ŋgepca, manmo aindoprina, “Kacoot aimo otac! Aia maica ŋgocraina mamoek!”

Ri, ma mina kam rutica aindopatna, “Ne kaina moca nanambirena? Nena rɨtɨpaikca tekir koind.” Karica ma ŋgepca watapa, murmurapa macaitmo kaega moca kɨracrina, mbatca mina anduna menaca tɨkca, pukca nuknukir kocor koind.
Ainda moca mina tamtamma ndamŋica aindopatna, “Anna titocna ramoot? Na ma watapa, murmurapa macaitmo kaega moca mina mana kamb mbaraca mamairi.”
Iesusa ramoot mbuniŋna ŋerŋgaur ŋgorikca moa kecariatna

Aintik Iesusa kor mbuŋa taŋga Galili mɨarmo waŋembai magacat, na anmbai waŋa anna Gadarana pitrik. Anna tɨkatke, ŋerŋgaur ŋgorikca mbukca eacrina ramootniŋa an warir mutocrina taup ndeacrinanna maniŋa man ndambuŋ makɨpat. Na an ramootniŋa, maniŋa kocnaia rorecarica meikramtaɨra an taupca mba taŋrenanna.
Karica maniŋa manmo aca aindopatna, “U Raraŋ Aetaniacna Nuoc, u aŋmo kaia mona moek? U gade kɨpca aŋmo gɨrgɨr neaŋna moekca? Mana ra mba larureke.”
Na mimo tawancait motemma wanaiŋa, markɨmta tumbun ianna ambri eacri.
Na an ŋerŋgaur ŋgorikca manmo kamb anik keca gaindopatna, “U aimo mo kecarina mo te, u aimo mandaca aia an markɨmbca mbukna.”

Karica ma minmo aindopatna, “Ne taŋ.” Na mina an ramootniŋ tɨkcarica an markɨmta tumbunna mbukatke, an markɨmta tumbunna muruŋ ŋgoinna ootta taŋga mɨar roumbna pacwɨkɨnna taup ŋgoreac ianna pukca, pukca mamenacat.
Na an markɨmb raupŋirena ramtaɨra kɨpcarica, mina taŋga an auŋ ndaruca, minmo an ramootniŋapa an reik larurinan maniniat.
Ri, an auŋna meikramtaɨra muruŋa Iesus ndambuŋ nakɨpca, mina mana watca, mina mamo aemaŋmaŋap mbopca, ma mina pitrik waŋ tɨkcarica taŋ.

footnotes.text: Iudanaŋgepca mina Tɨp Wandɨkca gaindopatna, meac, co, ramootta an lepaapna roumbap, ma Raraŋ Aetaniacna lamnɨac ŋgoutmo ma ratta mba eacitndai.
Ramootna Nuoc: Iesusa ndomo gaind ŋgacrena, Ramootna Nuoc. Na anna ndo manmo ainda wandacrina, manmo Raraŋ Aetaniaca babuca larapaca gargar aniacapa i aniac neaŋgatna.
